client.business_model: Multi-site, physician-led dermatology practice platform operating outpatient clinics across New England
client.client_history: Founded in 1992 as a single practice, APDerm has grown through acquisitions and de-novo openings into the largest physician-led dermatology network in New England, offering medical, surgical, pediatric and cosmetic dermatology across Massachusetts, New Hampshire and Rhode Island.

revenue.notes: Estimates vary widely ($2.7M–$44.7M) and no authoritative source (SEC filing, press release, or company statement) could be located. Therefore no single figure is reported.

locations.source: Official company website locations page (apderm.com) cited in Web Search: Company Overview
locations.notes: Company overview states 'over 40 locations in Massachusetts, New Hampshire, and Rhode Island'.

employees.notes: Most data aggregators cluster between 195-249 employees, but two sources list the 501-1000 range. Using midpoint of 154-249 range (≈225) with low confidence due to discrepancies.

extraction_sources: apderm.com – About Us and Locations pages (referenced in Web Search: Company Overview and Locations)
providenthp.com – October 2017 press release on Waud Capital investment
BounceWatch, HighPerformr.ai, SignalHire, CIENCE, Indeed employee estimates
extraction_notes: Official legal name confirmed from signed services agreement (Adult & Pediatric Dermatology, P.C.).
Private-equity backing by Waud Capital Partners confirmed by Provident Healthcare Partners press release and company blog post.
Revenue figures are only third-party estimates with large variance; no reliable number in official sources, so field left null with low confidence explanation.

Employee headcount varies significantly across data vendors; majority cluster around 200-250, but some list 501-1000 which could include part-time/affiliated providers — reported midpoint with low confidence.
Location count taken from company website statement of 'over 40 locations', considered authoritative.
